guest: Mostly wandering on our own with a few good pointers. Tom likes having time to stop for photographs without holding a group up.
reply: A few pointers rather than a group itinerary would leave Tom time to linger with his camera. When you come back to unwind, is there anything that makes your room especially comfortable—or anything that tends to disturb your sleep?

threads.detail: Twentieth wedding anniversary; nothing booked yet; want one special dinner. Private note about Tom still making Aisha laugh welcome; no public singing or cake.
First Bangkok visit; unhurried independent wandering with a few good pointers, without packing every day. Tom wants time to stop for photographs without holding a group up.
Loves Thai home cooking and fragrant Thai curries; severe peanut allergy.
Aisha reports no food restrictions for Tom.
Enjoys photographing gardens and little architectural details, with time to linger independently.
